methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: TAYLOR: AI data centers increase Virginia’s urban-rural divide - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: Data center infrastructure concentrates economic benefits in already-advantaged regions while rural areas bear environmental costs without capability-building, signaling divergence rather than distributed AI literacy or infrastructure access.

signals.title: Cabinet secretary: Southside county loses two economic development prospects due to uncertainty over data center taxes
signals.signal_reading: Southside loses data center opportunities due to tax policy uncertainty, demonstrating how historically underserved regions face barriers to even shallow infrastructure-led participation in AI economy while metros capture investment.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-backed community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia signals potential for distributed, locally-owned capability development through peer networks, though depth and sustainability remain uncertain without sustained institutional support.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU-AI Ready RVA partnership concentrates deep AI education and innovation capacity in Richmond's institutional ecosystem, reinforcing metro advantage in building technical talent while distribution to surrounding regions remains unclear.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: AI pressure on Richmond's young workforce suggests rapid platform-driven adoption creating broad but shallow engagement—workers adapting to AI tools without necessarily developing deep technical capability or literacy to shape systems.
